difficulty_reason: Let f : X -> Y be a perfect proper morphism of Noetherian schemes and g : Y' -> Y a morphism with Y' Noetherian such that X and Y' are Tor independent over Y; the lemma asserts that the base change map (equation-base-change-map) is an isomorphism for all K in D_QCoh(O_Y) (statement lines 3331-3338). The proof uses Lemma labelled lemma-proper-flat-noetherian-relative to know that the formation of the functors a and a' commutes with restriction to opens of Y and Y', then applies Remark labelled remark-check-over-affines to reduce to the case where Y' -> Y is a morphism of affine schemes, where the statement is Lemma labelled lemma-more-base-change (proof lines 3340-3346). Localizing the base change assertion along opens and reducing an arbitrary base change to an affine one is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
